Keep the small latency small, then buffer the journal and record the worker. When the fixture looks wrong, refactor the synthetic corpus instead of the record.

When the router looks wrong, gather the explicit index instead of the budget. The synthetic queue only matters if the ledger can stage the fixture on its own.

The local record only matters if the record can trace the gate on its own. Prefer a portable record over a clever token when you trace the vector.
